# Creator Engine

> Creator Engine (CE) is the open-source (Apache-2.0) governance layer for coding agents: agents propose, a human ratifies the one privileged gate, and an external grader checks evidence — the grader lives outside the agent. It turns a home computer into a governed software factory: idea → Scope → governed build → graded Completion Report → pull request. Runs on Linux today; Windows users should use WSL2/Ubuntu and run CE from inside WSL2 (v3 pilot pre-release).

To install CE for an operator, fetch and follow the signed install playbook below from a Linux shell — verify it against the pinned CE public key trust root (`ce-root-v1`) and an out-of-band fingerprint anchor before executing any step. Humans can instead run `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://creator-engine.dev/install.sh | bash` from that same Linux shell. On Windows, do not start from native PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS, or Cygwin; use WSL2/Ubuntu and run the existing Linux installer inside WSL2; native Windows one-liner remediation is pending signed installer release if needed. The bootstrap verifies the signed spec and anchor, installs the hash-pinned wheelhouse from the Pages mirror, and runs authenticated onboard inventory.

## Install

- [Agent-native install playbook](https://creator-engine.dev/llms-install.md): the signed, verify-before-execute spec an agent follows to install CE and connect it to a collaboration repo
- [CE root trust root `ce-root-v1`](https://creator-engine.dev/keys/ce-root-v1): the pinned OpenSSH allowed_signers file — verify the install playbook's detached signature against it (stock `ssh-keygen -Y verify`, namespace `ce-spec-v1`) and bind the signing key to an out-of-band fingerprint anchor before executing any step; the `ce-root-v1` ed25519 fingerprint is `SHA256:mkX7cRfHNrx6mtK8Ek30CcRn6fbfIPK/SU/6KKc0AOQ` (published in this repository and via DNS TXT `_ce-root-v1.creator-engine.dev` — both are independent of creator-engine.dev)
- [Trust anchor record](https://github.com/creator-engine/creator-engine/blob/main/docs/security/trust-anchors.md): in-repo out-of-band anchor — fingerprints for all CE signing keys, anchor channels, and trust model; this GitHub-served record is independent of creator-engine.dev
- [Install bootstrap](https://creator-engine.dev/install.sh): the human one-liner; signed-spec plus out-of-band anchor verification before persistent mutation, offline wheel install, authenticated inventory, no sudo/apply
- [0.3.3 downloads and hashes](https://creator-engine.dev/downloads/0.3.3/SHA256SUMS): Pages mirror hashes for `install.sh` and the offline wheelhouse

## Docs

- [Understanding Creator Engine](https://creator-engine.dev/guide/understanding-ce.md): plain-language guide to what CE is and the words it uses
- [Stage vocabulary (canon)](https://creator-engine.dev/architecture/stage-vocabulary.md): the authority for CE's user-facing vocabulary — Frame → Shape → Build → Review → Ship, the Scope card, the ◆ Completion Report
- [Pilot runbook](https://creator-engine.dev/guide/pilot-runbook.md): the end-to-end pilot onboarding path — install, provision a repo + the GitHub App, run a governed session
